subject.title: fix(openai): enable prompt cache keys for Azure

question: After this branch is rebased, should OpenClaw default Azure OpenAI Chat Completions routes to prompt-cache-key support for official Azure hosts and provider id `azure-openai`?
rationale: This is a compatibility-sensitive provider default: official docs and live proof support the behavior, but it changes the request payload for existing Azure chat-completions users.

options.title: Accept Azure default after port
options.body: Rebase/port the PR, preserve explicit `compat.supportsPromptCacheKey: false` and long-retention override coverage, then let maintainers own the official-host default.

options.title: Keep Azure explicit-only
options.body: Do not auto-detect Azure chat completions; require users to keep setting `compat.supportsPromptCacheKey: true` per model to avoid any default payload change.

options.title: Narrow to provider id only
options.body: Enable the default only for `provider: "azure-openai"` and leave URL-only Foundry/custom Azure host detection explicit until more upgrade proof exists.

recommendation.title: Accept Azure default after port
recommendation.body: Rebase/port the PR, preserve explicit `compat.supportsPromptCacheKey: false` and long-retention override coverage, then let maintainers own the official-host default.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main ownership and the provider-path refactor both point to this area for deciding and porting the compatibility default.
